content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe the stages of the menstrual cycle
Explain the roles of FSH, LH, oestrogen, and progesterone
Describe how hormones interact to control the cycle
Understand the relationship between ovulation and fertility

is a monthly cycle of changes in the female reproductive system controlled by hormones. It prepares the body for pregnancy each month. Understanding this cycle is essential for understanding fertility, contraception, and reproductive health.

Four hormones: FSH, LH, oestrogen, progesterone
FSH: stimulates follicle development and oestrogen production
Oestrogen: thickens uterus lining, triggers LH surge
LH: triggers ovulation on approximately day 14
Progesterone: maintains uterus lining after ovulation
If no pregnancy: progesterone falls, menstruation occurs
Complex feedback between hormones coordinates the cycle
